text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик has gotten used to playing
the villain
since she entered the role for
the autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite her efforts, people start to
notice her
gentle nature.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the final battle of the year
approaching, it
becomes clear that she'll
be able to run as her
true self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
